# Cosindra MotionSmith foot performance

Publisher: Cosindra. Source: [Right foot pain, free take 1](https://cosindra.ai/motionsmith/motions/pain-right-foot).
Acquired 2026-11-17 through the publisher's designated free download.

The source page marked this take free and permitted commercial game use on the
free plan, in any engine, without attribution. No paid subscription, purchase or
paid generation was used. Publisher [terms](https://cosindra.ai/terms) and
[license](https://cosindra.ai/license) govern use. This is an AI-generated catalog
performance, **not human motion capture**. The intended use is within this game.

Unchanged original: `Motions/MotionSmith_pain_right_foot_take1.fbx` (1,255,020 bytes).
SHA-256: `e49bfb9c5c4ac2a8bcc5945c07d19a881f91718d98ff390e198ab9d918b95e7d`.
It has 89 bones, 120 motion frames at 30 fps, and no character mesh.

`Derived/RightFootPain_Humanoid.fbx` adds a neutral reference at frame zero while
preserving the original animated joint transforms. The Unity Humanoid clip uses
only frames 1–120. Final model-specific native clips under
`Assets/_Game/Animations/Injuries/` fit support, mirror sides and add standing
transitions; the raw source is unchanged. Rebuild instructions and assert-based
preservation checks: [source preparation](../../../SourceAssets/CosindraAnimations/README.md).

Other downloaded MotionSmith candidates remain local, ignored source caches;
their availability does not establish a completed or accepted regional reaction.
